summary: Learn electric fleet transition and charging operations with practical tools, smart charging planning, and rollout templates for fleet teams.
lede: Electric fleet transition and charging operations covers matching vehicle use, charging capacity, and depot routines to daily service needs. Designed for fleet operations, transport, maintenance, and charging professionals, the course addresses practical deployment planning through duty-cycle and load analysis, charger scheduling, and depot operations design. Participants also practice monitoring charger uptime and energy use, mapping rollout risks, and setting phased implementation milestones and KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who sit between fleet operations, charging infrastructure, maintenance, energy planning, and leadership reporting. You will get the most value if you already handle day-to-day fleet data, site operations, or transport planning and now need to make electrification decisions that work in practice.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises and be ready to work with sample fleet schedules, charging demand data, and planning templates. Familiarity with Excel or comparable spreadsheet tools is sufficient; no programming or engineering software is required.
